artifact: Revised encoder: P for measured widths 20–22 mm inclusive; H for unmeasured spacers; T for measured widths 23–24 mm. Decoding table: P → pack; H → measure; T → trim. Regenerated messages: S1 → P; S2 → H; S3 → T.
explanation: The original H combined cases requiring different actions. Adding T distinguishes trimming while preserving P → pack and H → measure. The three encoding cases are mutually exclusive and cover every permitted spacer, using three single-character messages.
